acceptance: Document architectural evaluation and workload requirements for streaming incremental engines vs warehouse-native incremental views.
Define an incremental or continuous-refresh benchmark pattern compatible with BenchBox's execution model.
Determine adapter requirements for RisingWave/Materialize (PG wire) and warehouse-native incremental options (Snowflake Dynamic Tables, Databricks DLT, BigQuery continuous MVs).
description:
Evaluate and support incremental analytics workloads and engines across two primary architectural tiers:

1. Dedicated streaming SQL engines: RisingWave and Materialize (incremental materialized views, Kafka/Redpanda sources, Postgres wire compatibility).
2. Warehouse-native incremental features: Snowflake Dynamic Tables, Databricks Delta Live Tables (DLT) / Structured Streaming, and BigQuery continuous queries + materialized views.

Key design needs & constraints:
- Benchmark fit: Standard batch TPC-H/TPC-DS power runs evaluate cold query execution rather than continuous view maintenance, data freshness latency, or stream-to-view update throughput.
- Workload adaptation: Design or adapt an incremental benchmarking workload (e.g., continuous event ingestion with concurrent read queries, or TPC-H refresh/maintenance extensions).
- Adapter interfaces: Wire protocol integration for PG-compatible streaming DBs vs feature flags / DDL extensions for existing cloud warehouse adapters.
